scope: Official data.police.uk force and neighbourhood identity, centre and monthly-boundary safeguards

rows.observed: official force list excludes British Transport Police from the returned force collection
rows.effect: BTP must be handled as a separate location type and not inferred missing

rows.observed: force endpoints use a unique force identifier for force-specific requests
rows.effect: force identity must be stored with every neighbourhood binding

rows.observed: coordinate lookup returns both force and force-specific neighbourhood identifiers
rows.effect: both identifiers are required before requesting neighbourhood detail or boundary

rows.observed: neighbourhood identifiers are force specific and may be reused by another force
rows.effect: neighbourhood ID alone is not a globally unique key

rows.observed: the neighbourhood centre point may not be exactly at the centre of the neighbourhood
rows.effect: centre point cannot replace the neighbourhood polygon or parcel geometry

rows.observed: force boundaries stay constant while neighbourhood policing team boundaries may change each month
rows.effect: neighbourhood geometry must be pinned to the evidence month

rows.observed: the boundary endpoint returns latitude and longitude pairs for the specified force and neighbourhood
rows.effect: boundary rows require force plus neighbourhood plus evidence-month provenance

rows.observed: exact parcel coordinates, locate-neighbourhood responses, monthly boundary bytes, reconciliation and three final SHA256 values are absent
rows.effect: score remains null
